invariants.rationale: The method returns the same list instance after sorting, so result and records refer to the same List object.
Since no elements are added or removed, the size remains unchanged and is the same in both references.
Partition counts are very likely required to be non-negative as a basic contract of partitioning.
HoodieRecord lists likely prohibit nulls, as they would break downstream processing in a repartition operation.
After in-place sorting and since the same instance is returned, the content and order of result and records should be identical.
